question: Who is the first Indian Female Dancer to receive the highest Padma award, Padma Vibhushan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is the first Indian female dancer to be honored with the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, in the field of art.
 
• She received this award in the year **1992** for her outstanding contribution to Indian classical dance.
 
• Mansingh is a renowned exponent of **Odissi** and **Bharatanatyam**, two of India's most celebrated classical dance forms.
 
• She is also known for her innovative choreographies that address contemporary social issues, blending traditional and modern themes.
 
• In addition to the Padma Vibhushan, she has also been awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in 2003 and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 1987.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian awards in India, comprising three categories: **Padma Vibhushan**, **Padma Bhushan**, and **Padma Shri**.
 
• They are awarded in various disciplines such as art, literature, social work, public affairs, science, and sports.
 
• **Padma Vibhushan** is the second-highest civilian award, given for "exceptional and distinguished service."
 
 
 
• **Odissi Dance:**
 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is characterized by its fluid movements, intricate footwork, and sculpturesque poses inspired by temple architecture.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam Dance:**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form from Tamil Nadu, known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate hand gestures, and facial expressions.
 
• It is one of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, with roots in Natya Shastra, an ancient Sanskrit text on performing arts.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:**
 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, established in 1953.
 
• It presents awards to artists for their outstanding contributions to Indian performing arts.
